letAppReadChange: Let {{app}} read and change files in <dir>{{dir}}</dir>?
reasonRead: The app wants to read the files in this folder.
reasonWrite: The app wants to create, change or delete files in this folder.
reasonReadWrite: This app needs to save your edits.
reasonReadWriteUnavailable: The app wants to read the files in this folder. This app needs write access, but you can only read here.
trustNote: The app never receives your login. Agenta makes the file calls for it. Only allow apps you trust: the app's code can read these files and may be able to send what it reads outside Agenta.
whatAppMayDo: What the app may do with the files in <dir>{{dir}}</dir>
pageNotFound: Page not found in the app folder: {{path}}
navigationStopped: The app tried to load another page and was stopped. Refresh to restart it.
readOnlyTip: The app can read its files but not save changes
navigationStoppedBody: The app tried to load another page and was stopped. Use Refresh to start it again.
stylesheetOutside: Stylesheet outside the app folder was not loaded: {{ref}}
imageOutside: Image outside the app folder was not loaded: {{ref}}
scriptNotHttps: Script not loaded, only https:// scripts can run: {{src}}
scriptNotHttpsEmpty: Script not loaded, only https:// scripts can run: (empty src)
scriptOutside: Script outside the app folder was not loaded: {{src}}
scriptNotFound: Script not found in the app folder: {{src}}
couldNotAssemble: Could not assemble the app document: {{message}}
